infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo Search reads your photos on-device to build a searchable index. Photos are never uploaded anywhere except as a resized copy sent to the AI provider you configure, solely to generate a text description for search.

plugins.photosPermission: Photo Search reads your photos on-device to build a searchable index.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Photo Search does not need to save photos, but the system requires this permission string.
